excerpt: Plan for Ajman apartment rental costs beyond advertised rent, from deposits and lease authentication to utilities and moving.
introduction:
The advertised annual rent is only one part of the cash needed to rent an apartment in Ajman. A tenant may also face a security deposit, brokerage, lease authentication, utility setup and moving costs. The amounts and responsibility depend on the property, provider and signed agreement.

Ask for an itemised quote before paying anything. This guide separates recurring expenses from refundable deposits and uses a worked example to show how to prepare for move-in and the rest of the lease.
takeaways: Request the full rent payment schedule and all additional charges in writing.
Keep refundable deposits in the cash plan even though they may be returned at the end of the tenancy.
Check utility, cooling, maintenance and early-exit terms for the actual apartment.

sections.heading: Which costs can sit outside the rent?
sections.body:
Ask the landlord or authorised agent for the annual rent, number and dates of payments, deposit, commission and any administrative charges. Verify which amounts are refundable, when they are due, who receives them and what conditions apply. A low first cheque does not necessarily mean the full tenancy is inexpensive.

Ajman's [residential lease authentication service](https://ajman.ae/en/happiness-bundle/services/establish-business/authentication-lease-contract-residential-purposes) describes an electronic Tasdeeq application. Confirm the current fee and the responsible party for your lease with the authority and the parties to the agreement. Avoid treating an advertised fee or a figure for another emirate as an official quotation.

The [Ajman area guide](/journal/ajman-property-2026) helps compare neighbourhoods, but exact costs must be checked for each unit and agreement.

sections.heading: Work out move-in cash
sections.body:
Suppose a fictional tenant agrees annual rent of AED 42,000 in four equal payments. The first payment is AED 10,500. Add an assumed AED 2,500 security deposit, AED 2,200 agency charge, AED 800 lease charge, AED 2,000 utility deposit and AED 1,500 moving cost. The initial cash requirement is AED 19,500. None of these sample amounts is a current Ajman fee or a quote.

The remaining rent payments total AED 31,500, so the example's first-year cash outflow for these items is AED 51,000. If both deposits are returned in full, the non-refundable amounts shown total AED 46,500. Actual utility consumption, internet, furnishings and other costs are excluded. The calculation does not predict that a deposit will be returned.

Put each payment on a calendar and keep money for the later cheques. A deposit returned after moving out cannot fund an earlier instalment.

sections.heading: Clarify utilities and cooling
sections.body:
Ask whether electricity, water and cooling are included or separately billed, and whether the apartment has its own meter. Request the provider's current connection requirements and the landlord's responsibility for any existing balance. [Etihad Water and Electricity's tariff page](https://etihadwe.ae/en/About/Pages/Tariff.aspx) lists consumption categories and tariffs; check the category and applicable terms directly.

A deposit or connection charge should be distinguished from ongoing consumption. Ask about internet installation, the permitted provider and any minimum contract term. If cooling is supplied separately, obtain the current billing basis and ask about fixed as well as usage-related charges.

For an existing unit, request permission to review recent bills if available. They are context, not a guarantee of your own costs, because household use and weather vary.

sections.heading: Read maintenance and exit terms
sections.body:
The agreement should identify who arranges and pays for routine repairs, major equipment faults, pest control and damage. Ask how to report a fault and what happens if a necessary repair is delayed. Inspect cooling, plumbing, locks, appliances and visible marks before handover.

Record the condition with dated photographs and an inventory agreed with the landlord. For a furnished apartment, list furniture and working appliances. Ask how deposit deductions are assessed and when the balance is returned. Keep proof of payments and correspondence.

Read renewal, notice and early-termination clauses, including any payment due if you need to leave. Ask for clarification in writing before signing; a verbal assurance is difficult to reconcile with a different written term.

sections.heading: Check costs that arise later
sections.body:
Ask in advance whether a renewal involves a new authentication or administration charge, and confirm the notice dates in the agreement. An apartment that is affordable in the first month can still strain the budget when the next cheque, annual internet payment or car insurance falls due at the same time.

Also check building rules for moving hours, lift booking and parking. If the tenant must arrange a move-in permit or pay a refundable building deposit, add it to the cash calendar and obtain written return conditions. These items vary by building, so request the current policy for the specific unit rather than assuming a fixed amount.

sections.heading: Compare the complete annual cost
sections.body:
Prepare one worksheet per apartment: annual rent, known non-refundable fees, expected utilities, commuting, parking and any required furniture. Add deposits separately to show peak cash needed. A higher rent with included services may be cheaper overall than a lower rent with several separate bills.

Ask for a signed quote and verify the person receiving funds is authorised to let the unit. Check the exact apartment, building and availability, and keep the agreement and receipts. Avoid deciding solely from a photograph or headline price.

sections.heading: Ask for current property terms
sections.body:
Browse the [Aliyas Ajman projects](/projects?emirate=Ajman) to explore residential developments and ask which relevant homes are available to rent. A project page does not by itself confirm an apartment is offered on a particular lease.

[Contact Aliyas](/contact) with your preferred area, bedrooms and annual budget. Request an itemised current quote, payment dates and lease terms for any home you consider.
